name: Per-material lit pipelines in the renderer
body:
`lit.frag` splits into `lit-common.glsl` (the lighting, unchanged) and a surface function: `lit.frag` keeps the default `SurfaceOf` (texture times vertex colour times tint, the uniform metallic, roughness and emissive, the normal map), so every existing draw renders byte-for-byte the same. A material shader is the generated `SurfaceOf` plus the same include.

The renderer gets a material shader handle (`lantern:::renderer:::MaterialShader`) on `DrawItem`, a lit pipeline per handle (plain and skinned, created on first use), and the material's textures bound after the normal map (binding 4 onwards). The draw list sorts by pipeline first. A draw without a handle uses the default pipeline.
